hero_sub: AuraFlux is the production infrastructure for creators who can't afford to stop streaming to edit.
mission_body:
Most streamers and creators produce hours of content every week — and then lose most of it. Editing takes longer than the stream itself. Hiring an editor costs more than the content earns. So the clips sit on a hard drive, and the channel doesn't grow.

We built AuraFlux to close that gap. Not by making editing faster, but by eliminating the need for it entirely.
blockquote: Every creator should be able to produce like a media company. That's not a staffing problem — it's a software problem.

diff_cards.headline: A full pipeline, not a feature
diff_cards.body: Connect your YouTube and Kick channels once and the platform identifies, selects, assembles, quality-checks, and publishes for you.

diff_cards.headline: Platform-aware by default
diff_cards.body: Every output is sized, captioned, and formatted for the destination platform. TikTok gets 9:16. YouTube gets 16:9. No manual reformatting.

diff_cards.headline: AI quality checks at every stage
diff_cards.body: Before your content ever reaches a platform, our AI quality gates check it against your brand spec and technical requirements.

diff_cards.headline: Direct publish, no manual export
diff_cards.body: OAuth connections to every major platform mean your content publishes directly — no downloading, uploading, or scheduling tools needed.

diff_cards.headline: Collab guides you through it
diff_cards.body: Your plan includes Collab, the AuraFlux AI assistant. It monitors your pipeline, flags issues, and guides you to better outputs.

diff_cards.headline: API-first for technical operators
diff_cards.body: The entire platform is accessible via REST API. Integrate AuraFlux directly into your own tooling, dashboard, or workflow automation.

founder_bio: Started AuraFlux after spending years watching creators lose hours to manual editing. Built the platform he wished existed.
diff_sub: Not a tool. An automated production environment.
